info.title: Xenovia Control Plane API
info.description: Management API for proxies, providers, policies, telemetry, alerts and organization settings.

BearerAuth.description: Bearer token: an organization API key (`ak_…`) created under Settings → API Keys, or a dashboard user session token. Proxy keys (`xe_…`) are not accepted here. Endpoints marked as user-only in their description reject organization keys with `403`.

actions.update: Inference base URL for this proxy. Cloud proxies render `https://runtime.xenovia.io/{proxy_id}/v1`; hybrid proxies render their deployment's ingress URL plus `/{proxy_id}/v1`.
